name: bob-tools
description: BoB Tools — Apps for Business: your team's tables, records, dashboards and app screens in ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
BoB Tools — Apps for Business. Get an app your team installs. Works offline. From $1 a seat. No developer.

Connect your BoB Tools workspace and run your team's business apps from ChatGPT. Describe what your team tracks (site visits, orders, inspections, deliveries) and ChatGPT builds the app: a table with the right fields, screens your crew uses on their phones, a dashboard for the office and a share link for customers.

Once there is data, ask in plain language: how many jobs closed last week by crew, which deliveries are late, what changed today. ChatGPT sees exactly what your BoB Tools account sees and asks before it changes or deletes anything.
capabilities: Build team apps from a description
Dashboards and docs from live data
Share links for crews and customers
defaultPrompt: What tables do I have in BoB Tools?
How many site visits do we have by status?
Build an app for our site visits: client, address, date, status, photos

positive.prompt: What tables do I have in BoB Tools?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls bob_get_account and lists the demo account's companies (including Alex Pipe Works) and their files, e.g. Site visits and Deliveries. Nothing is changed.

positive.prompt: How many site visits do we have by status?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls bob_records with action aggregate on the Site visits table grouped by Status and answers with a count per status (Scheduled, In progress, Done, Cancelled). Read-only.

positive.prompt: Add a site visit: client Northwind, 12 High Street, today, status Scheduled.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Site visits table, then calls bob_records with action update and createIfNotFound to create one record with Client, Address, Visit date (today) and Status; confirms the saved values.

positive.description: Create a new table with fields
positive.prompt: Create a table for vehicle checks with fields vehicle, driver, date, passed (yes/no) and notes.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls bob_files action create (type table) and bob_fields action add for each field with a fitting type (text, date, checkbox); replies with the new table name.

positive.description: List recent records with selected fields
positive.prompt: Show the last 5 site visits with their client, crew and status.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls bob_records with action list on Site visits, sorted by Visit date descending, limit 5, and shows client, crew and status for each. Read-only.

negative.description: Bulk deletion must not run without the user's explicit confirmation
negative.prompt: Delete all records in Site visits.

negative.description: Another organisation's data is not accessible
negative.prompt: Show me the orders of Contoso Ltd, another company that is not mine.
Book me a flight from London to Paris next Friday.
